name: code-snippet-apple-terminal-pro-vertical
title: Apple Terminal Pro (vertical)
description: Vertical macOS Terminal in the Pro profile: the command types after the prompt, the output prints, a new prompt blinks. Title, prompt, command and output (lines up to 42 characters) are fields; the text is as large as its lines allow, 28 to 44 px, and the window as tall as they need; placement full, top or bottom; holds.
